verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a scraping and data API with AI features such as ai_query and GPT/Gemini passthrough, so a tunable-effort agent is a fair question for this kind of product. However, no evidence shows an autonomous agent with a selectable reasoning-effort level (low/medium/high). The closest feature, `mode=auto`, is a proxy/configuration cost-escalation ladder whose "only value is auto." It is not a user-set reasoning-effort control, so it is adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
